titulo: Quiz — The five questions you will be asked all week
introPt: A traveller gets through the standard set at a counter, and stays out of the one argument that was never theirs.
cenario: A counter mid-morning, one stool away from a regular.

dialogo.es: どちらからですか？ どのくらい滞在しますか？
dialogo.pt: Where are you from? And how long are you staying?
dialogo.tts: どちらからですか？ どのくらい滞在しますか？

dialogo.es: ロンドンから来ました。五日間います。日本は初めてです。
dialogo.pt: I'm from London. I'm staying five days. It's my first time in Japan.
dialogo.tts: ロンドンから来ました。五日間います。日本は初めてです。

dialogo.es: 東京なんて、もう日本じゃないですよ。本当の日本は関西です。
dialogo.pt: Tokyo, honestly, isn't Japan any more. The real Japan is Kansai.
dialogo.tts: 東京なんて、もう日本じゃないですよ。本当の日本は関西です。

dialogo.es: まだ来たばかりで、比べられません。こちらのご出身ですか？
dialogo.pt: I've only just arrived, I can't compare. Are you from around here?
dialogo.tts: まだ来たばかりで、比べられません。こちらのご出身ですか？

perguntas.pergunta: Why answer with a city rather than a country?
opcoes: A city gives the other person something to say back
perguntas.explica: A fact ends a turn; a city hands over a hook. Then add sochira wa.

perguntas.pergunta: Saying nihon wa hajimete desu — my first time — usually gets you:
opcoes: Instructions — where to eat, which district, which day the market runs
perguntas.explica: Claiming familiarity you do not have closes that door, and there is nothing worth having on the other side.

perguntas.pergunta: Nihongo o-jozu desu ne, said after four words of Japanese, is:
opcoes: The standard encouragement to keep going
A hint to switch to English
perguntas.explica: The only wrong answer is switching to English at exactly that moment.

perguntas.pergunta: Someone insists the capital is not the real country. Your move:
opcoes: Say you are still discovering it and cannot compare, then ask about theirs
Change the subject to the weather
perguntas.explica: The Kanto-Kansai argument long predates your trip. Agreement from a visitor carries no weight and travels badly.

perguntas.pergunta: What does the EF index actually support about English in Japan?
opcoes: That a specific percentage of people speak English
That measured proficiency is low and not improving
That English is spoken at every counter
perguntas.explica: The sample is self-selected and online, by EF's own admission, so it cannot be read as a share of the population.
